newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Fraser says growth best way to cut jobless.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Fraser says growth best way to cut jobless.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) governor Bernie Fraser said solid economic growth was the best way to reduce unemployment.

"The best way to reduce unemployment is to keep the economy growing at a solid rate," Fraser said in response to a question after a BZW seminar in Tokyo. His comments were broadcast on Reuters Financial Television (RFTV).

"To the extent that inflation can be kept under control, as I think it will, that will make a signficant contribution, monetary policy will make a signficiant contribution to achieving lower levels of unemployment over time," Fraser said.
